Held approving order EO 6725-A (APP, May 28, 1934): stays Article VII Section 6 'pending my further order' (so 'Section G' in EO 6743 is an OCR error for 6, as the claim says) and imposes the 90-day Code Authority report on Articles III-V
Printed copy jobs/hathi-gpo-orders EO_6725 is the Science Advisory Board order, as the claim says; WPA dates EO 6743 June 15, 1934 (p. 581), APP and held text June 16
reasoning: Three operative commands, all inventoried. Clause 1 stays the code's effective date 'until July 9, 1934': own-terms end 1934-07-09, recorded inclusive with the exclusive reading disclosed, as the 2026-10-21 until-date ruling requires. Clause 2 lifts the approving order's stay of Article VII Section 6, putting that provision in force as code text; its continuing effect is the code's operation, so the June 14, 1935 repeal under S.J. Res. 113 section 2 is the right first end, not exhaustion on issuance. Clause 3 extends the Code Authority report date to November 15, 1934; treating the deadline as a spent fact and ending the clause with the repeal of the code under which the duty and the related modification window existed is consistent with the report-deadline ruling. Observation, not a defect that changes any date: the ruling asks that the spent report date be recorded as a later_event; the claim records 'functionally spent on November 15, 1934' only in the reason and leaves later_events empty. Held-text searches find only EO 6725-A and this order on the baking code; no earlier cancellation, 10(b) modification or suspension. Schechter correctly recorded as validity characterization; June 16, 1935 correctly rejected. Savings: accrued effects only; nothing continues the approval.
